description: A property the system must have beyond its features: performance, SEO, maintainability, testability, team autonomy, cost, accessibility, availability.
Improving one attribute by paying with another. SSR buys SEO and first paint with server cost; a SPA buys cheap hosting with first-load performance.
Google's user-centric performance metrics: LCP (loading), INP (responsiveness) and CLS (visual stability).
How much of the system a change can affect. Low coupling keeps it small and maintainability high.
An ordered list of the quality attributes that matter for a product. It turns opinion debates into explicit choices.
